frontend_manual_checks: Open the dashboard and confirm the layout loads without clipping or overlap
Connect one available device and confirm its name platform and identifiers are correct
Check navigation tabs buttons forms filters and validation messages
Confirm loading indicators error messages and empty states are understandable
Check keyboard focus and the main workflow at the supported window size
backend_manual_checks: Review server logs for exceptions timeouts and failed jobs
Check that request references map to the correct user and device
Review database or transaction records for duplicates where access is available
Confirm license limits and queued work are expected
Retest open backend defects and attach request references as evidence
